title: Zero Detector
statement: Create an 8-bit zero detector that asserts output when all bits of the input are zero. The circuit should return zero otherwise. It is a simple combinational check used in branch condition generation and comparator datapaths.
behavior: is_zero is 0 for any nonzero input.
Do not infer registers or sequential logic.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use a sequential loop or latch inference.
hint: All bits must be compared to zero in a single combinational expression.
